source.quote:
Executive Order 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, and Executive 
Order 11800 of August 17, 1974, as amended, are hereby revoked.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The sole clause amends section 104(b)(1) of EO 11157 to its two-hours-of-aerial-flight form. Under the strike-and-insert ruling it continued, amended, until the parent order ended. EO 13294 of March 28, 2003, Sec. 2, revoked the parent: Executive Order 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, "are hereby revoked." (68 FR 15917). EO 13294 has no delayed effective date, and no held later instrument restated section 104 before that.

title 37, United States Code, and as President of the U nited States and 
Commander in Chief o f the Arm ed Forces o f the U nited States, section 
104(b)(1)  of Executive O rder N o. 11157 1  o f June 22, 1964, as 
amended, is amended to read as follow s:
“ (1) During one calendar m onth: 2 hours of aerial flight; however,

research_rationale:
EO 11728 (July 12, 1973) amended section 104(b)(1) of EO 11157 (incentive pay for hazardous duty involving aerial flight) to require 2 hours of aerial flight in a calendar month, with carry-over of hours flown in the preceding five months. Under the strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 an amendment continues, amended, until the parent order ends. EO 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, was revoked by EO 13294 of March 28, 2003 (Sec. 2), which also delegates the underlying statutory authority (37 U.S.C. 301, 301a and 301c) to the Secretaries. The status is NO: the parent order carrying the amended section 104(b)(1) was revoked on March 28, 2003.
